b: I’m 29 and have been lonely for my entire life. I have never had friends, and am looking for someone who resonates and wants a friendship where we can openly talk about those things. If you reach out, please understand that I'm looking for someone who is also in a place where, when asked how they're doing, they'd almost always answer "depressed" rather than "good," "fine," or "bored", etc. I hope we can work together to make things better for both of us, but starting from common ground.

I'm currently unemployed and trying to find work. I don't have much to do during the day besides apply for jobs and look for friends. I like serious, somber conversations and exchanging long texts throughout the day. My interests include music, medicine (which I've studied and worked in), philosophy, technology, sci-fi, fantasy, horror, and writing. We could watch movies together, exchange long letters, start a book club, study together, eat together, apply for jobs together, or just talk about our days.

I am open to people of any gender or background, as long as you match the above criteria. My only other preference is that we have overlapping schedules (I am in the eastern U.S. time zone and free all day, except midnight to early morning). If this sounds like the kind of friendship you'd like, I'd be happy to hear from you.
